next.settings.lead.connections: Your tracker, wiki and code host: agents read tasks and pages from them
next.connections.title: Connected
next.connections.empty: Connect your tracker, wiki or code host, and agents read its tasks and pages. A link is enough.
next.connections.foot: Tokens are kept encrypted in this machine's safe and never come back to the page. Agents read with them; they do not change anything.
next.connections.paste: Paste a link to your tracker, wiki or code host
next.connections.paste.placeholder: Any link: a task, a page or the home page
next.connections.noSignIn: It is open to read without signing in.
next.connections.name: Name
next.connections.state.denied: The service no longer accepts this token: connect it again with a new one
next.connections.state.unreachable: The service did not answer at the last check
next.connections.disconnectSure: Disconnect «{name}»? Agents stop reading it, and its token is removed from the safe.
next.connections.reason.denied: The service refused these credentials — check the token and its permissions
next.connections.reason.unreachable: The service did not answer. Check the address, or try again in a minute.
next.connections.reason.unknown-product: We could not recognize this link. Paste the address of the tracker or wiki itself.
next.connections.reason.unsupported: This service or sign-in method is not supported yet
next.connections.reason.read-only: This connection is set by the machine and cannot be changed here
next.connections.reason.bad-request: The machine did not understand the request
next.connections.reason.other: The machine did not take the change ({code})
next.connections.mcp.title: MCP servers
next.connections.mcp.lead: Agents in new chats get the tools of these servers
next.connections.mcp.signs.oauth: Signs in on its own page
next.connections.mcp.oauthUnavailable: This service does not let new apps sign in by themselves: create a token on its site and paste it here.
next.connections.mcp.header.name: Header
next.connections.mcp.state.signin: Agents cannot use it until you sign in
next.connections.mcp.state.token: The server does not accept the token: enter a new one
next.connections.mcp.state.unreachable: The server did not answer at the last check
next.connections.mcp.waiting: Finish signing in in the window that opened
next.connections.mcp.blocked: The browser blocked the sign-in window
next.connections.mcp.disconnectSure: Disconnect «{name}»? Agents lose its tools, and its sign-in is removed from the safe.
next.connections.mcp.foot: Sign-ins and tokens are kept encrypted in this machine's safe and never come back to the page. Agents reach the servers through this machine.
next.connections.mcp.reason.denied: The server refused this sign-in or token
next.connections.mcp.reason.unreachable: The server did not answer. Check the address, or try again in a minute.
next.connections.mcp.reason.bad-request: The machine did not understand the request — check the address
next.connections.mcp.reason.signin-requi: The server needs you to sign in first
next.connections.mcp.reason.oauth-failed: The service did not finish the sign-in. Try again.
next.connections.mcp.reason.other: The machine did not take it ({code})
next.connections.mcp.state.oauthUnavaila: This service needs a token here: it does not let new apps sign in by themselves
